# SEO metadata audit and fix

Curated by Skill Harbor — @ibelick's rulebook for auditing and fixing HTML metadata on any site: eight rule categories ranked by priority — correctness and duplication (one metadata source per page, no duplicate tags, deterministic values), title and description (short, consistent, plain-text), canonical and indexing (canonical must match intent, noindex only where appropriate), social cards (Open Graph title/description/image with absolute URLs, og:url matching canonical, correct twitter:card), icons and manifest (favicon, apple-touch-icon, theme-color), JSON-LD structured data (valid, one block, never inventing ratings or prices), locale and alternates (lang, og:locale, hreflang only where real), and tool boundaries (minimal diffs, no framework migrations). It also defines when to invoke the skill — new pages, shareable links, metadata refactors — and insists on verifying social cards on a real URL, never localhost. MIT-licensed. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use. Discovered via skills.sh.
